summary: Executed backend pytest regression (12 tests) and full frontend Playwright flow against public URL. Core public/admin workflows work, but backend leaks MongoDB _id fields in create responses.
action_items: Sanitize create endpoint responses to exclude _id from /api/admin/gallery, /api/admin/artists, and /api/reservations.
Re-run backend pytest regression after response sanitization.
critical_code_review_comments: Mongo insertOne mutates inserted objects by adding _id; current handlers return spread objects that now include _id.
Ensure all API response payloads are normalized before returning (projection or explicit field mapping).
test_credentials: Missing/empty /app/memory/test_credentials.md; used credentials provided in review request.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary test artist/gallery/reservation data; cleaned up using /app/backend/tests/cleanup_test_data.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest currently fails only on _id leakage assertions. Full UI flow (home, coverflow, reservation, catalog search/pagination, admin auth/protection/stats/content/artists/reservations, mobile overflow) passed on public URL.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: POST /api/admin/gallery, POST /api/admin/artists, and POST /api/reservations return _id in JSON. RCA: inserted JS objects are likely mutated by MongoDB driver during insertOne, and route returns these mutated objects directly using spread. Mitigation: map explicit response DTOs or delete _id before sending responses.
